# Scarf

> Out-of-core, provenance-backed single-cell analysis for RNA, ATAC, protein, and matched multi-omic data. Follow the linked documentation for the installed release. Do not infer unsupported methods or biological conclusions.

## Start here

- [Home](index.html): design, implemented methods, validation, and current boundaries
- [Analysis with AI agents](analysis_with_agents.html): scientific decision loop, state inspection, task routing, troubleshooting, and handoff
- [Grounded agent workflow](tutorials/agent_workflow.html): executable enrichment, design, tuning, and biological-interpretation handoffs
- [Quick start](quickstart.html): minimal count-to-cluster workflow
- [API reference](reference/api.html): exact public signatures and result contracts

## Core analysis

- [scRNA-seq heterogeneity](tutorials/scrna_seq.html): filtering through marker interpretation
- [Quality control](tutorials/quality_control.html): modality-aware and sample-aware filtering
- [Feature selection](tutorials/feature_selection.html): feature-set diagnostics
- [Graph construction](tutorials/graph_construction.html): granular normalization, reduction, neighbours, and graphs
- [Dimensionality reduction](tutorials/dimensionality_reduction.html): PCA dimensions and layout comparison
- [Clustering](tutorials/clustering.html): Leiden, Paris, stability, connectivity, and markers
- [Cell type annotation](tutorials/annotation.html): marker interpretation and label assignment

## Integration and inference

- [Dataset merging](tutorials/dataset_merging.html): compatible stores and an uncorrected joint baseline
- [Batch correction](tutorials/batch_correction.html): partial PCA, Harmony, mixing, and structural preservation
- [TEA-seq](tutorials/tea_seq.html): prepared RNA, ATAC, and protein analysis with three-way WNN
- [Mapping and label transfer](tutorials/mapping_and_label_transfer.html): fixed-reference projection
- [Pseudobulk and differential expression](tutorials/pseudobulk_and_differential_expression.html): biological-replicate aggregation and export

## Trajectory analysis

- [Pseudotime](tutorials/pseudotime.html): supervised sources and sinks
- [Expression dynamics](tutorials/expression_dynamics.html): feature profiles and modules
- [Fate mapping](tutorials/fate_mapping.html): multiple terminal outcomes
- [Trajectory validation](tutorials/trajectory_validation.html): boundary, graph, statistical, and numerical checks

## State, scale, and extension

- [Provenance](concepts/provenance.html): artifacts, reuse, lineage, and limits
- [Reuse and tracing](tutorials/reuse_and_tracing.html): executable branching example
- [Memory and execution](concepts/memory_and_execution.html): resource budgets and scale
- [Benchmarks](concepts/benchmarks.html): measured end-to-end timings and peak memory
- [Remote stores](tutorials/remote_stores.html): object-storage execution
- [Custom analyses](tutorials/custom_analyses.html): public extension and export boundaries
- [FAQ](reference/faq.html): concise method and interoperability answers
